# TradePulse Nepal

> TradePulse Nepal is an independent public-data project for exploring Nepal foreign-trade statistics. It processes Department of Customs, Government of Nepal releases into analysis-ready datasets and explanatory reports.

## Primary resources
- [Nepal Trade Data](https://tradepulsenepal.com/nepal-trade-data.html)
- [Download Nepal Trade Data](https://tradepulsenepal.com/nepal-trade-data-download.html)
- [Nepal Import Data](https://tradepulsenepal.com/nepal-import-data.html)
- [Nepal Export Data](https://tradepulsenepal.com/nepal-export-data.html)
- [FY 2083/84 Trade Data](https://tradepulsenepal.com/nepal-trade-data-2083-84.html)
- [Bhadra FY 2083/84 Trade Report](https://tradepulsenepal.com/bhadra-2083-84-trade-report.html)
- [Shrawan FY 2083/84 Trade Report](https://tradepulsenepal.com/shrawan-2083-84-trade-report.html)
- [Methodology](https://tradepulsenepal.com/about.html)

## Current release
Latest processed release: Bhadra FY 2083/84, cumulative through the first two months (mid-July to mid-September 2026).

Headline cumulative values:
- Imports: Rs 401.52 billion
- Exports: Rs 76.59 billion
- Merchandise trade deficit: Rs 324.93 billion
- Total merchandise trade: Rs 478.11 billion
- Import/export ratio: 5.24x
- Import growth vs comparable first two months: 31.58%
- Export growth vs comparable first two months: 61.86%

Derived Bhadra-only movement:
- Imports: Rs 214.08 billion
- Exports: Rs 37.88 billion
- Trade deficit: Rs 176.19 billion

Important: the official Bhadra workbook is cumulative. TradePulse does not present two-month cumulative totals as Bhadra-only values.

## Provenance
Primary source: Department of Customs, Government of Nepal.
Processing and derived analysis: TradePulse Nepal.
TradePulse Nepal is not the original government publisher.

Canonical site: https://tradepulsenepal.com/
